---
title: "Research"
---

My research uses urban big data, AI, and spatial econometrics to understand how cities and housing markets work — from WiFi-sensed public life to online housing market signals.

## Software

**urban-wifi-sensing-toolkit** — an open-source R toolkit covering the full WiFi sensing pipeline for urban research, from sensor construction and data collection to urban metrics.
